name: gh-agentic-workflow
description: Skills, agents, commands and hooks for AI-assisted development, split into focused plugins.

plugins.name: agent-sessions
plugins.description: Run and steer agent sessions: pilot sessions, session titles, conversation focus hooks, PR and tracker watching, grievances, usage tracking.

plugins.name: agent-tooling
plugins.description: Tooling for building and maintaining agent setups: plugin release, static-validation hooks, LSP over MCP, ESLint standards for NestJS.

plugins.name: audit
plugins.description: Audits — rigorous, evidence-based reviews of a system (front-end, database, infrastructure, security) that produce a triaged findings report, driven by open-source tooling run in Docker.

plugins.name: backend-and-data
plugins.description: Backend and data practices: SQL migrations, pg-boss with Drizzle, data-first philosophy, OpenAPI client generation, API collection conversion, MCP spec templates.

plugins.name: docker-and-k8s
plugins.description: Containers and clusters: Dockerfile patterns, hot-reload volumes, Compose port management, Kubernetes troubleshooting, private npm registries in images.

plugins.name: frontend
plugins.description: Frontend building blocks: Lit web components, cursor glow canvas effect, text clip effects, live Web Component demos in Starlight.

plugins.name: git-and-delivery
plugins.description: Git workflows and delivery pipelines: commits, merges, activity reports, CI/CD design, semantic-release, Makefile conventions, SonarQube, version surfaces.

plugins.name: review-and-projection
plugins.description: Adversarial multi-model review and pre-implementation projections of a change onto files and data.

plugins.name: speckit
plugins.description: Spec-driven development on top of GitHub Spec Kit (requires spec-kit installed): orchestration agents, specify/plan/tasks pipeline, spec indexing, E2E specs, Notion sync.

plugins.name: testing-and-debugging
plugins.description: Testing and investigation: Playwright end-to-end suites, auth fixtures, per-environment test targeting, web analysis, scraping, debugging.
